verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question for a hosted voice-agent SaaS like Retell, so the axis applies. The pack never documents choosing a storage region or residency. Per-agent data retention controls how long data is kept, not where it is stored, so it is an adjacent control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
